description: 2SK209-GR low-noise N-channel JFET, GR grade (the BD-2's 2SK184-GR in SMD; our model from Toshiba's sheet)

source.licence: Our own model built from the maker's data sheet (D-159, D-161): the values are Solum Builder's

package.name: SC-59 (S-MINI)
package.source: Toshiba 2SK209 data sheet (2014-03-01), page 1: 1. Source 2. Drain 3. Gate

fit.figure: |Yfs| - IDSS, ID - VGS and ID - VDS (typical, page 2)
fit.method: Idss the geometric middle of the GR grade's 2.6-6.5 mA (4.11 mA). Vp -0.487 V from the typical |Yfs|-IDSS figure (16.9 mS at that Idss) by the square law, Vp = -2·Idss/|Yfs|; the ID-VGS figure agrees (its 3.6 and 5.3 mA curves are square laws with Vp -0.47 and -0.55 V, where this rule gives -0.46 and -0.55). The VGS(OFF)-IDSS figure reads -0.63 V at this Idss, but at 0.1 µA, in the tail a square law doesn't follow. BETA = Idss/Vp². LAMBDA from the ID-VDS figure's VGS = 0 curve, about 17 µS at 2.7 mA. CGD = Crss 3 pF, CGS = Ciss − Crss = 10 pF (typical).
fit.note: Real units spread over the grade's range; a circuit's measured Idss and Vp replace these (D-130)
